description.full:
Snowdonia Adventures (SNOWDONIA ADVENTURES LIMITED, Companies House no. 05117191) has been delivering outdoor adventures and mountain skills training in north Wales since 2000. Based at Bron Hafod in Ceunant — a hamlet a few kilometres from Caernarfon with immediate access to the peaks and gorges of Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park — the company caters for individuals, groups, schools, and those pursuing professional mountaineering qualifications.

The activity range spans guided ascents of Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon) and other Eryri summits, multi-day mountain skills courses, scrambling expeditions, canyoning, rock climbing, abseiling, kayaking, canoeing, coasteering, and navigation training. The company also runs winter mountaineering programmes. Staff hold Summer Mountain Leader qualifications as a minimum, with more senior guides holding Mountain Instructor Award/Certificate, International Mountain Leader, and British Mountain Guide credentials.

A directorship change took effect on 30 September 2025, when Reece Robinson replaced founding director Mark Handford. The company's TripAdvisor profile holds a 4.9/5 rating across 83 reviews as of June 2026.
